figures.title: Imatinib reference-neutral chemical state
scientific_limitations: 2D depiction of the selected chemical state, not a conformer.
Generated hydrogen positions and state populations are not shown.
Atom labels are reference-graph indices, not deposited atom names.
The drawing is not an interaction, energy, or affinity diagram.
figures.alt_text: Two-dimensional chemical structure of imatinib with donor and acceptor atoms highlighted and reference atom indices shown.
figures.caption: Reference-neutral imatinib graph. Blue atoms are hydrogen-bond donors, orange atoms are acceptors, and purple atoms are both. Atom labels are reference indices; hydrogens are omitted.

figures.title: Imatinib in the ABL1 binding site
scientific_limitations: One crystallographic structure and one selected ligand copy.
Cartoon and surface are representations of the deposited coordinates, not new data.
The ligand orientation is from the crystal structure, not a predicted pose.
No binding free energy or interaction favourability is shown.
figures.alt_text: Protein cartoon of ABL1 with a yellow imatinib molecule in the binding pocket and a pale transparent surface around nearby residues.
figures.caption: Imatinib (yellow sticks) in the ABL1 binding site, chain A. The pale surface marks protein residues within 4 Å of the ligand. This is one crystallographic observation, not an ensemble or an affinity estimate.

figures.title: Imatinib binding-pocket contacts
scientific_limitations: Dashed lines are measured atom-atom contacts, not classified hydrogen bonds.
The figure does not show hydrogen positions or angular criteria.
Nearby waters are geometric observations; water roles remain unassigned.
The figure does not imply energetic favourability or binding affinity.
figures.alt_text: Close-up of the imatinib binding pocket with cyan contact residues, a yellow ligand, blue waters, and gray dashed distance measurements for three polar contacts.
figures.caption: Binding-pocket close-up. Cyan residues are contact residues, yellow sticks are the ligand, and blue spheres are nearby waters. Gray dashed lines are measured donor-acceptor distances for three polar contacts; they are not classified hydrogen bonds. No energetic interpretation is implied.
